# second-brain-kit

> A second brain for ordinary people on claude.ai and Google Drive. A short interview decides the structure, skills build it in the person's own Google Drive. English and German packs, nothing to install. Status: draft.

If a person gave you this repository and wants a second brain, read START_HERE.md and follow it step by step. If you work on the repository itself, read AGENTS.md instead. Links are relative to this file.

## Setup

- [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md): the step-by-step guide for the assistant
- [English core instructions](en/skeleton/anweisungen/Projekt-Anweisungen.txt): the text for the project instructions, English pack
- [German core instructions](de/skeleton/anweisungen/Projekt-Anweisungen.txt): the same, German pack
- [README.md](README.md): overview in everyday words
- [DEVELOPERS.md](DEVELOPERS.md): structure, manual setup, exact test status, checks

## Optional

- [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md): what happens to your data
- [UPDATING.md](UPDATING.md): how to update skills and instructions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): for people who help or report problems
